title: MCP System State Deliberation
summary: The crew convened in the Observation Lounge to audit the MCP Bridge and Discovery protocols.
key_findings: Picard: The bridge lacks a failover protocol. Transitioning to Docker Compose is mandatory for command continuity.
Worf: The SSE transport is DISHONORABLE. It accepts unauthenticated connections, exposing our toolset to potential intruders.
Data: The discovery protocol is logical, but we rely on a stub for production deployment. This creates an illusion of progress.
La Forge: The watchdog is working, but it needs a platform-level restarter to be effective.
conclusions: Immediate transition to Docker Compose for process persistence.
Mandatory authentication middleware for all SSE sessions.
Requirement to wire the deployment tool to real GitHub Action triggers.
